title: Vanishing makes the Leray edge an isomorphism
statement: For a morphism f:X to Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let H^q and R^q f_* be the module cohomology and higher direct image functors [pqf-def-cohomology] of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose a family of natural homomorphisms from H^q(X,-) to global sections of R^q f_* satisfies the cocycle characterization [lem-pc-leray-edge-cocycle-data]. For every module sheaf F such that H^p(Y,R^q f_* F) is zero for every p>0 and every q, each degree-q component of this family on F is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Assume $H^p(Y,R^qf_*\mathcal F)=0$ for every $p>0$ and every $q$. Via [pqf-def-cohomology], these are precisely the terms $R^pG(R^qF(\mathcal F))$ off the $p=0$ column of the first-quadrant spectral sequence supplied by [thm-sp-grothendieck]; its finite decreasing abutment filtration is part of the convergence data used by [lem-sp-grothendieck-edge-maps]. The collapse and edge-isomorphism clause of [lem-pc-grothendieck-edge-cocycle], equivalently [lem-sp-edge-collapse] applied to that finite filtration, makes the canonical left edge $H^q(X,\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(Y,R^qf_*\mathcal F)$ an isomorphism. By Step 2 this edge is $\varepsilon^q_{\mathcal F}$, proving (2).

proof.text: The cocycle characterization identifies the given edge with the canonical Grothendieck edge. Each cohomology class is represented by a global cycle; its lift to the cycle sheaf is unique since the cycle inclusion is a monomorphism and global sections preserve monomorphisms. The two edge values therefore agree on every class. Transfer the canonical edge isomorphism to the given edge.

lean.statement: theorem leray_edge_isIso_of_vanishing {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (ε : LerayEdge X Y f) (hε : LerayEdgeCocycle f ε) : (∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)), (∀ (q p : ℕ), 0 < p → IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived q).obj F))) → ∀ q : ℕ, IsIso ((ε q).app F))
